map.先去掉首尾空白；匹配原始字符串形式（r 后跟若干个井号再加引号，且整体以引号结尾: Leading and trailing whitespace is removed first; when the text matches the raw-string form (r followed by several hashes and a quote, ending with a quote), it locates the inner content by the number of hashes and outputs it directly. Otherwise it strips the leading byte-string prefix b, then matching outer double or single quotes. It scans character by character: on a backslash followed by another character, it escapes by the following character — n to newline, r to carriage return, t to tab, 0 to the null character, and backslash and single/double quotes to themselves; x takes the following 2 hex digits as a code point; u followed by an opening brace takes the hex digits up to the closing brace as a code point and skips past it, otherwise it takes the following 4 hex digits; otherwise the following character itself is taken. Characters that are not escape sequences are kept as-is
